coverage_notes: R3-001 (packet 03 / C9 reconciliation) established this directory with the first 6 files (C18/C19/C20/C21/G6/G7).

R3-003 (this packet, F-39/F-36/F-38) adds 6 new steps (C1, C2, C7, C8, C14, G5; C2 and C8 each emit multiple artifacts, hence 11 new files for 6 steps), hardens the G6/G7 evidence-object subschema (fabricated `{note:...}` evidence now rejected), adds a severity enum to B3, and closes the `id,evidence`-only thin-contract gap for D1's four sub-artifacts and E2 by promoting fields the runtime/prompt already treats as load-bearing (D1: path+line_range, already enforced today via the RUNNER_MINIMUM_REQUIRED_KEYS fallback in lib/phase_contract_map.py; E2: `name`, the env-var name explicitly named in its own Extraction Procedure).
